tasks.short: Compile and interpret wetland biodata for classification and programs.

steps.what: Choose actual biodata sources and verify survey definitions, provenance and coverage
inputs: actual wetland/program question
actual available survey and habitat records
outputs: chosen verified biodata sources and compilation rules

steps.what: Compile existing biodata records into the wetland assessment workspace
inputs: chosen verified biodata sources and compilation rules
actual existing survey-owner exports
outputs: staged biodata compilation with provenance and unmatched records

steps.what: Check compilation and interpret actual biodata for wetland extent, type or program needs
inputs: staged biodata compilation with provenance and unmatched records
chosen verified biodata sources and compilation rules
outputs: actual wetland interpretation, uncertainty and program implications

steps.what: Write and check actual wetland findings and retain the internal assessment record
inputs: actual wetland interpretation, uncertainty and program implications

tasks.design: Test native biodata import in {DATA_PLATFORM} before a deterministic bridge from actual {SPREADSHEET} exports. Remove repeated compilation while retaining source selection, full checks, ecological interpretation and complete written findings; no new survey or wetland determination is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing survey tables may be compiled by hand across stores.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned mappings can preserve source identity and flag unmatched records.
tasks.still_hard: Seasonality, coverage and habitat meaning need ecological judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when incomplete seasonal evidence cannot establish wetland extent.
tasks.altitude: Less biodata handling; ecological decision rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic compilation can transfer existing biodata while wetland interpretation remains scientific work.

assumptions: Provisional scenario requires actual manual compilation30 today; existing imports/runtime earn zero credit. Actual source surveys already exist, and source selection/checking remain20/40. New field observation is not inferred or removed; if required in this task, count it and reweight before estimating.

Actual survey owners supply survey/site id, coordinates/reference system, date/season, species or habitat observation, cover/presence unit, method and provenance/version. Missing definitions or records require manual owner clarification. Internal written assessment and ordinary save are retained without self-approval.
unknowns: How much actual compilation is manual and how stable are survey definitions?
research_questions: Can staged compilation preserve season, method and uncertain locations without silent matches?

incremental.description: Maintain biodata mappings, source versions and unmatched-record handling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes30 manual compilation points minus1 upkeep=29. Low: most historical surveys lack consistent habitat codes and stay manual; only10 points of current structured survey compilation disappear, minus1=9. Source selection, checking, ecological interpretation and written findings stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review and approve amendments to water or conservation district plans.

steps.what: Locate exact proposed plan amendment, current plan and relevant conservation evidence
inputs: actual plan-owner-authored amendment proposal
actual current water/conservation plan and supporting sources
outputs: located exact amendment version and current source packet

steps.what: Review actual amendment effects, evidence, conflicts and water or conservation plan consistency
inputs: located exact amendment version and current source packet
outputs: actual substantive amendment assessment and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and check actual amendment review findings and retain the internal assessment
inputs: actual substantive amendment assessment and unresolved issues
outputs: checked saved final amendment assessment and exact proposed amendment version

steps.what: Decide whether to approve the plan owner's exact final proposed amendment
inputs: checked saved final amendment assessment and exact proposed amendment version
outputs: actual authorised amendment approval decision and exact version

steps.what: Commit the authorised exact amendment approval status in the formal plan register
inputs: actual authorised amendment approval decision and exact version
outputs: actual formal plan-register approval status and audit entry

tasks.design: Configure exact amendment/current-plan source links in {DOCS} and the plan-register {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain substantive review, complete written assessment and actual approval of the plan owner's proposal; formal approval-status commitment is separate at1 point with no saving, while ordinary assessment saving stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current plan and amendment versions can require repeated locating.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version-linked sources can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Water-system effects and conflicting conservation objectives need expert review.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist identifies an amendment that shifts risk beyond the plan boundary.
tasks.altitude: Less plan-source navigation; approval rights stay with the existing authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact-version plan links can reduce locating work without replacing conservation amendment review or approval.

assumptions: Provisional approval-authority route: the scientist reviews a distinct plan owner's amendment, not an amendment she authored. s4 is the actual statement-specified approval decision, not self-approval of s3 notes. If this scientist only recommends, map actual authority instead; do not invent an approval job.

Plan owner supplies actual amendment id/version and source changes; plan/evidence owners supply current versions and applicable context. Missing or conflicting versions require manual clarification. Three of15 source points are navigation; reading/review stay. s5 is formal plan-status commitment, not an ordinary file save, and earns zero saving. No extra external notice is invented.
unknowns: Does this scientist hold actual amendment approval authority or only review?
research_questions: Can source links bind a decision to the correct amendment and current base plan?

incremental.description: Maintain exact plan/amendment source links and access.

approvals.approved_version: exact plan-owner-authored amendment and approval status decided in s4 after final assessment s3; any amendment or decision change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated plan-source navigation points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: a novel cross-district amendment requires manual sources, leaving only0.5 current-base-plan locating points removed, minus0.4=0.1. Review, written findings, actual approval and1-point formal commitment retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review wetland restoration easements and provide technical recommendations.

steps.what: Read the actual proposed wetland restoration easement and identify its terms and questions
inputs: actual proposed wetland restoration easement and attachments
outputs: understood actual easement terms and technical questions

steps.what: Locate and verify actual wetland/site evidence and applicable restoration-plan sources
inputs: understood actual easement terms and technical questions
actual site records and restoration-plan sources
outputs: verified applicable easement technical source packet

steps.what: Develop, write and check actual easement technical recommendations and retain the internal assessment
inputs: understood actual easement terms and technical questions
verified applicable easement technical source packet
outputs: checked saved actual easement technical recommendations

steps.what: Discuss actual technical recommendations and limitations with the requesting team
inputs: checked saved actual easement technical recommendations
actual requester questions
outputs: actual technical recommendation discussion and responses

tasks.design: Configure current site/restoration evidence links in {DATA_PLATFORM}/{DOCS}. Reduce repeated locating work while retaining easement reading, ecological/technical assessment, complete written recommendations and actual requester discussion; ordinary internal save has no self-gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable site and restoration sources may be scattered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site-identity links can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Restoration obligations and ecological feasibility need case-specific assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist identifies an easement term inconsistent with actual restoration conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less technical-source navigation; easement recommendations stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native site-evidence links can reduce locating work while wetland easement recommendations require expert assessment.

assumptions: Provisional source20 includes three repeated locating points; substantive source checks remain. Written recommendations25 are actual task work, not excluded as conversation, and remain fully retained with ordinary internal save. This route provides advice live to an internal requesting team; no additional send or conveyance is invented.

Proposal owner supplies actual easement version and parcel/site identity; survey/plan owners supply actual evidence date, method, restoration targets and limitations. Missing evidence requires manual owner clarification or actual fieldwork, reweighted if assigned. Native existing links earn no new credit. No legal title conclusion or easement execution is automated.
unknowns: Which current site evidence and recommendation route are actually available?
research_questions: Can evidence links preserve uncertainty and distinguish proposed restoration from observed condition?

incremental.description: Maintain site/restoration source links and applicability labels.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 technical-source navigation points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: a new restoration site lacks indexed evidence, leaving only1 current-plan locating point removed, minus0.4=0.6. Easement reading, written assessment and recommendation discussion retain their time.

tasks.short: Develop soil maps from actual soil evidence.

steps.what: Choose and verify actual soil survey sources, mapping scale and classification definitions
inputs: actual soil-map purpose
actual available soil-survey records and spatial sources
outputs: chosen verified soil-map sources and mapping specification

steps.what: Transfer existing soil attributes and spatial layers into the mapping workspace
inputs: chosen verified soil-map sources and mapping specification
actual existing survey-owner spatial layers and soil tables
outputs: staged soil-map layers with source provenance and unmatched attributes

steps.what: Develop soil map delineations and assess actual classification and boundary uncertainty
inputs: staged soil-map layers with source provenance and unmatched attributes
chosen verified soil-map sources and mapping specification
outputs: actual interpreted soil-map delineations and uncertainty

steps.what: Prepare soil-map legend, scale layout and chosen classification display
inputs: actual interpreted soil-map delineations and uncertainty
chosen verified soil-map sources and mapping specification
outputs: complete soil-map draft with source/uncertainty labels

steps.what: Check complete soil map against actual sources, coordinates, classifications and uncertainty
inputs: complete soil-map draft with source/uncertainty labels
chosen verified soil-map sources and mapping specification

steps.what: Save the final soil map in the internal mapping workspace
inputs: checked final soil-map version

tasks.design: Test native geospatial import in {DATA_PLATFORM} before bridging actual soil tables/layers from {SPREADSHEET} and source stores. Configure repeat legend/layout sections while retaining soil-source verification, scientific delineation and complete final checks; the1-point ordinary internal save stays ungated with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing soil layers and attributes may be transferred repeatedly before map preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned layer mappings and native layout sections can remove handling work.
tasks.still_hard: Soil classes, mapping scale and boundary uncertainty need scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist refuses to draw a sharp soil boundary unsupported by the surveys.
tasks.altitude: Less layer movement and map-layout assembly; soil interpretation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic layer transfer and native cartographic layouts can assist soil maps while classification and delineation remain scientific work.

assumptions: Provisional existing-survey mapping case with actual manual transfer20 and three of10 repeat layout points. Existing imports, geospatial processing runtime or layouts earn zero new credit. New soil field surveys are not inferred: if needed and assigned here, count them and reweight before estimating.

Actual survey owners supply layer/source id/version, coordinates/reference system, sample/site id, date, depth/unit, classification scheme and provenance. Scientist verifies source applicability in s1 and mismatches/uncertainty in s3/s5; absent fields require manual source clarification. No automated soil-class decision. Actual publication/distribution is outside this internal map preparation and must be separately mapped if assigned.
unknowns: Which existing soil layers and attributes are actually moved by hand?
research_questions: Can imports preserve depth, coordinate and classification definitions while flagging unmatched soil records?

incremental.description: Maintain soil-layer mappings, source definitions and layout revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 transfer plus3 layout points minus1.3 upkeep=21.7. Low: historical soil surveys need manual digitisation/attribute reconciliation, leaving only5 current-layer transfer points and1 stable legend-layout point removable, minus1.3=4.7. Source verification, scientific delineation, complete checking and1-point save retain their time.
